name: twist-kadal
description: Lizard-brain content with a twist: danger or happy mode, then a surprisingly simple payoff.

interface.longDescription: Turns a topic, product, or offer into short-form content ideas and scripts that hit the lizard brain (danger mode or happy mode) and pay off with a small, true, surprisingly simple answer. Built for batch testing: many variants, keep the winners.
defaultPrompt: Make 10 twist-kadal content ideas for this topic.
